icons.name: Home
icons.secondary_details: Door cutout; one chimney pixel block
icons.notes_32: Roof owns the silhouette; body remains rectangular and squat.
icons.simplification_16: Keep roof + door; remove chimney if crowded.

icons.name: Projects
icons.notes_32: Use the canonical thick folder body; tab reads before color.
icons.simplification_16: Keep tab + rectangular body; drop inner file edge.

icons.name: Architect
icons.secondary_details: Center hub with four attached nodes
icons.notes_32: Match geometric node language used by architecture diagrams.
icons.simplification_16: Keep center + three nodes minimum; no tiny labels.

icons.name: Canvas
icons.notes_32: Frame reads as a physical drawing surface, not a modern image icon.

icons.name: Forge
icons.notes_32: Tools are chunky and diagonally opposed; Forge is mechanical, not magical.
icons.simplification_16: Keep two crossed silhouettes; remove small jaw detail.

icons.name: Memory
icons.secondary_details: Pins on four sides; green core
icons.notes_32: Square IC silhouette with visible pins; center remains simple.
icons.simplification_16: Keep square chip + four corner/side pin cues.

icons.name: Launch
icons.notes_32: Rocket is short and industrial, not cartoon tapered.
icons.simplification_16: Keep nose + body + one exhaust pixel.

icons.name: Explorer
icons.notes_32: Same family as project folders but more mechanical depth.

icons.name: Settings
icons.notes_32: Canonical mechanical gear; teeth are blocky, not radial hairlines.

icons.name: Search
icons.notes_32: Lens must remain obvious at 16×16; avoid thin circular outline.

icons.name: Notifications
icons.notes_32: Bell uses a broad metal silhouette with a single clapper.
icons.simplification_16: Keep bell body + clapper; drop rim highlight.

icons.name: Terminal
icons.notes_32: Physical monitor/terminal, not a floating code glyph.
icons.simplification_16: Keep monitor body + dark screen + one prompt pixel.

icons.name: Minimize
icons.notes_32: Glyph centered low in existing molded control.

icons.name: Maximize
icons.notes_32: Hard square, 2px mass, no rounded corners.

icons.name: Restore
icons.meaning: Return maximized window to prior geometry
icons.notes_32: Front/rear frames overlap with clear depth ordering.
icons.simplification_16: Use two corner brackets if full overlap crowds.

icons.name: Close
icons.notes_32: Two diagonal bars with equal mass; not an anti-aliased thin X.
icons.simplification_16: Use four stepped pixels forming X.

icons.name: Pin
icons.notes_32: Pin reads vertically; broad head, short spike.

icons.name: Lock
icons.notes_32: Shackle is squared/stepped, not smooth.

icons.name: Resize
icons.notes_32: Corner-origin geometry, aligned to lower-right.

icons.name: Float
icons.notes_32: Physical panel separation; arrow is secondary.
icons.simplification_16: Keep offset panel; remove arrow at 16.

icons.name: Entity
icons.notes_32: Center hub dominates; connectors are 2px minimum.
icons.simplification_16: Center + 3 terminals; remove inner hub accent.

icons.name: Service
icons.notes_32: Human bust is broad and simple; no facial micro-detail.

icons.name: Flow
icons.notes_32: Squares and 2px connectors; direction readable without arrows.

icons.name: API
icons.notes_32: Blueprint grid with side ports; avoid app-window metaphors.

icons.name: Screen
icons.notes_32: Physical CRT body with blue display.

icons.name: Database
icons.notes_32: Use stacked storage drum silhouette; no cloud/database modern glyph.

icons.name: Auth
icons.notes_32: Key and lock form one combined silhouette.

icons.name: Queue
icons.notes_32: Physical inbox/tray stack, horizontal direction.

icons.name: Gateway
icons.notes_32: Mechanical portal frame; arrows secondary.

icons.name: Event
icons.notes_32: Beacon/object first; rays must not dominate.
icons.simplification_16: Keep beacon + one ray per side.

icons.name: Cache
icons.notes_32: Cartridge/block first; lightning is a cut/notch, not a modern bolt logo.

icons.name: Worker
icons.notes_32: Industrial worker silhouette; gear is secondary.

icons.name: Cron
icons.notes_32: Clock face is chunky; schedule semantics from hands.
icons.simplification_16: Clock + two hands; remove gear edge.

icons.name: Connector
icons.notes_32: Physical plug connection, no chain-link metaphor.
icons.simplification_16: Two plug heads + one connector line.

icons.name: Route
icons.notes_32: 90-degree orthogonal route, no curved navigation arrow.

icons.name: Webhook
icons.notes_32: Socket/port object first; callback arrow secondary.

icons.name: Storage
icons.notes_32: Physical crate/cabinet, not cloud bucket.

icons.name: Function
icons.notes_32: Module block with ports; mathematical mark secondary.
icons.simplification_16: Block + two side pins; omit fx mark.

icons.name: AI Agent
icons.notes_32: Machine object, not sparkle/brain abstraction.
icons.simplification_16: Robot head + eyes; remove antenna if needed.

icons.name: Cluster
icons.notes_32: Three blocks must read as coordinated unit.

icons.name: Cursor
icons.notes_32: Classic arrow with stepped diagonal edge.

icons.name: Move
icons.notes_32: Orthogonal cross; arrowheads square/stepped.

icons.name: Pencil
icons.notes_32: Diagonal pencil with chunky shaft.

icons.name: Brush
icons.notes_32: Physical brush object, heavy handle.

icons.name: Rectangle
icons.notes_32: Hard rectangle frame; no rounded corners.

icons.name: Circle
icons.notes_32: Deliberately pixel-stepped perimeter.

icons.name: Arrow
icons.notes_32: 2px shaft minimum; triangular/stepped head.

icons.name: Frame
icons.notes_32: Open frame with strong corners.

icons.name: Grid
icons.notes_32: Square technical grid, not spreadsheet app chrome.

icons.name: Magnet
icons.notes_32: U-shaped physical magnet.

icons.name: Duplicate
icons.notes_32: Offset physical layers.

icons.name: Group
icons.notes_32: Outer bounding box is primary semantic.

icons.name: Align
icons.notes_32: Mechanical alignment to a ruler/datum.

icons.name: Layer
icons.notes_32: Physical stacked sheets, parallel offsets.

icons.name: Comment
icons.notes_32: Square callout, no rounded chat bubble.

icons.name: Build
icons.notes_32: Hammer silhouette must dominate.

icons.name: Compile
icons.notes_32: Source document and gear joined physically.

icons.name: Package
icons.notes_32: Box/crate, not gift icon.

icons.name: Deploy
icons.notes_32: Launch is deployment action; keep industrial rocket.

icons.name: Publish
icons.notes_32: Physical transmitter first.

icons.name: Test
icons.notes_32: Clipboard/document is primary; check is secondary.

icons.name: Debug
icons.notes_32: Blocky bug silhouette; no cute curves.

icons.name: Pipeline
icons.notes_32: Orthogonal production-line metaphor.

icons.name: Logs
icons.notes_32: Paper/log strip, not terminal alone.

icons.name: Rollback
icons.notes_32: Artifact first; reverse action secondary.

icons.name: Git
icons.notes_32: Branch topology, not vendor logo.

icons.name: Merge
icons.notes_32: Two-to-one junction clearly visible.

icons.name: Commit
icons.notes_32: Physical stamp on file.

icons.name: Docker
icons.notes_32: Generic containers only; vendor logo reserved for EXT.

icons.name: Container
icons.notes_32: Shipping/runtime container, strong rectangle.

icons.name: Folder
icons.notes_32: Canonical folder; same tab geometry everywhere.

icons.name: Open Folder
icons.notes_32: Open state shown physically via flap/cavity.

icons.name: File
icons.notes_32: Canonical folded-corner sheet.

icons.name: Image
icons.notes_32: File silhouette first, image cue second.

icons.name: Video
icons.notes_32: Film perforations imply video without modern play-button dominance.

icons.name: Audio
icons.notes_32: Physical speaker/reel cue.

icons.name: Code
icons.notes_32: Same document family as Script, fewer colors.

icons.name: Archive
icons.notes_32: Physical archive box used elsewhere in desktop.

icons.name: Upload
icons.notes_32: File remains primary.

icons.name: Download
icons.notes_32: File + receiving tray.

icons.name: Delete
icons.notes_32: Mechanical bin, not X-only glyph.

icons.name: Favorite
icons.notes_32: Primary object + star; do not use heart.

icons.name: Generate
icons.notes_32: Creation is a machine action, not sparkle magic.

icons.name: Remix
icons.notes_32: Two inputs cross/mix into one machine.

icons.name: Brainstorm
icons.notes_32: Physical ideation board/lamp; avoid lightbulb-only cliché.

icons.name: Analyze
icons.notes_32: Tool/object first, analysis secondary.

icons.name: Recall
icons.notes_32: Physical index/retrieval metaphor.

icons.name: Suggest
icons.notes_32: Recommendation shown as directed selection.

icons.name: Expand
icons.notes_32: Bounding frame primary; arrows square.

icons.name: Simplify
icons.primary_silhouette: Large block collapsing to small block
icons.notes_32: Two-state physical reduction.

icons.name: Compare
icons.notes_32: Parallel objects must be equal visual weight.

icons.name: Explain
icons.notes_32: Instruction manual metaphor, not chat bubble alone.

icons.name: Plan
icons.notes_32: Physical plan board/checklist.

icons.name: Multi-Agent
icons.notes_32: Multiple machine heads, clear network hierarchy.

icons.name: Voice
icons.notes_32: Physical microphone, not waveform-only.

icons.name: Vision
icons.notes_32: Physical camera/sensor.

icons.name: Automation
icons.notes_32: Mechanical automation apparatus.

icons.name: Live
icons.notes_32: Device + explicit live indicator.

icons.name: Context
icons.notes_32: Context is a physical stack of reference cards.

icons.name: Memory
icons.notes_32: Separate from desktop Memory app but same storage vocabulary.

icons.name: Save
icons.notes_32: Physical 3.5-inch disk, deliberately period-correct.

icons.name: Refresh
icons.notes_32: Blocky arrows, not smooth circular spinner.

icons.name: Undo
icons.notes_32: Single stepped return arrow.

icons.name: Redo
icons.notes_32: Mirror of Undo.

icons.name: Help
icons.notes_32: Manual/book first; question mark secondary.

icons.name: Info
icons.notes_32: Physical plaque/plate, not floating circle.

icons.name: Warning
icons.notes_32: Hard triangular sign, stepped corners.

icons.name: Error
icons.notes_32: Mechanical stop sign/plate, not modern toast icon.

icons.name: Success
icons.notes_32: Physical indicator lamp/check.

icons.name: Clock
icons.notes_32: Stepped circular/clock case.

icons.name: Calendar
icons.notes_32: Physical calendar page.

icons.name: Filter
icons.notes_32: Funnel/chute object, not abstract sliders.

icons.name: Sort
icons.notes_32: Bars imply ordering; one direction arrow.

icons.name: Link
icons.notes_32: Chunky chain/connector, no thin loops.

icons.name: Unlink
icons.notes_32: Same Link silhouette with explicit gap.

icons.name: Network
icons.notes_32: Physical devices with orthogonal connectors.

icons.name: Sound
icons.notes_32: Physical speaker object.

icons.name: Power
icons.notes_32: Physical power control, not naked circle-slash.

icons.name: User
icons.notes_32: Same bust grammar as Service, no role badge emphasis.

icons.name: Team
icons.notes_32: Three readable bust masses.
